newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distributions.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nitrogen sets cash distributions.

text.p: Terra Nitrogen Co LP said its cash distribution for the fourth quarter of 1996 will be paid in two parts.
A cash payout of $0.605 a unit will be paid February 28, record February 7, and a payout of at least $0.885 a common unit will be paid on April 30, record April 18.
It said the latter will represent the remainder of available cash for the 1996 fourth quarter.
Terra said current holders of senior preference units must convert their units to common units and must be holders of record on April 18 to be entitled to the April 30 distribution.

The company noted that as a result of the end of the preference period on December 31, 1996, senior preference units no longer are entitled to participate in quarterly cash distributions in excess of $0.605 per unit. Holders must convert their senior preference units to common units by March 31, 1997 in order to participate in any cash payouts above this level.
